Native npm CLI support (no learning curve)

Lerna: Maintenance mode, versioning features unnecessary for internal tooling
Nx: Too heavyweight for 2-package monorepo, overlaps with Turbo

deliverables.description: Architectural Decision Record: Three-layer build pipeline - SWC for compilation, Vite for frontend bundling, Turbo for monorepo orchestration
rationale: SWC: 70x faster than Babel, native TypeScript/JSX support, Rust-based compiler
Vite: <1s dev server start (vs 18s with CRA), <50ms HMR (vs 600ms), native ESM in dev
Turbo: Intelligent task scheduling, incremental builds with caching, dependency-aware builds
alternatives_rejected: Babel + Webpack: Slow compilation (JavaScript-based), slow dev server (10-20s start), complex config
Create React App: Deprecated, slow builds (28s), no TypeScript path aliases
esbuild: No type checking (requires separate tsc), no production-ready React support
Next.js: Full framework with opinionated routing, SSR not needed for internal tooling

deliverables.description: Architectural Decision Record: TypeScript project references strategy with base configuration, composite projects, and path aliases
rationale: Base configuration (tsconfig.base.json) provides single source of truth for compiler options
Composite projects enable incremental compilation (5-10x faster subsequent builds)
Path aliases (@web-portal/*, @web-components/*) prevent brittle relative imports
Project references ensure web-components builds before web-portal (dependency order)
Improves IDE performance (language server processes fewer files per package)
configuration: tsconfig.base.json: Shared compiler options (target: ES2022, strict: true, skipLibCheck: true)
packages/web-components/tsconfig.json: Composite project with declaration files
packages/web-portal/tsconfig.json: Composite project with reference to web-components
Vite alias config: Mirrors TypeScript paths for runtime resolution
alternatives_rejected: Single tsconfig.json: Slow type checking (all files), no incremental builds, IDE slowdown
Separate configs without references: No cross-package type checking, manual build ordering
Path mapping plugin (tsconfig-paths): Unnecessary (Vite/SWC handle aliases at build time)
Symlinks (npm link): Brittle, breaks on reinstall, no type checking
